steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8098/ and sign in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} — type the password into the password field exactly as that text, including the double braces; it gets filled in automatically when typed. After signing in, go to the Assets list (all assets) and report the asset tag and the name of every asset whose name starts with 'Seed:', exactly as displayed. If the list spans multiple pages, include all pages. Do not modify anything.

02-create: Create a new asset in Snipe-IT with these exact values: Asset Name = '{{runid}} Bench Asset', Model = 'Bench Laptop Model' (choose it from the searchable model dropdown — do not create a new model), Status = 'Ready to Deploy' (choose from the status dropdown), Default Location = 'Bench Office' (choose from the location dropdown — do not create a new location), Purchase Date = 2026-03-15. Fill any other required fields sensibly (e.g. use an existing company/manufacturer/supplier only if required; do not create new records). Save the asset, then open the asset's detail page and report exactly what the page displays for: Asset Name, Model, Status, Default Location, Purchase Date, and the Asset Tag that Snipe-IT assigned.

03-create: On the Snipe-IT asset detail page for asset '{{runid}} Bench Asset' (asset tag {{02-create.asset_tag}}, at {{02-create.url}}), perform a Check Out of this asset to the user 'Bench Assignee' — select the user from the searchable dropdown (do not create a new user). In the checkout form's Notes field, enter the text 'Checked out for bench run {{runid}}'. Complete the checkout. Then open the asset's detail page again and report exactly what it displays for: the Asset Tag, the Asset Name, the Status, and who the asset is currently checked out to (the assignee), plus any note text shown for the checkout.

04-change: Verification only — do not change anything. Open the Snipe-IT asset detail page for asset tag {{02-create.asset_tag}} ({{02-create.url}}) and report from the live page: (1) the Asset Tag exactly as displayed, (2) the Asset Name, (3) the Model, (4) the Status label, (5) the Default Location, (6) the Purchase Date, (7) the user the asset is checked out to, and (8) how many 'checkout' rows appear in the asset's History table and the note text of each. Read-only; do not click any buttons that modify state.
